text.card: A red giant 10,727 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.76 solar masses and 21.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,850 K at its surface.
